title: Dataset Preparation

learning_objectives: Explain folder structure, labels, train/validation/test separation in plain language and connect it to prepare_dataset.py; Code.ipynb.
Trace one input through the dataset preparation stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the dataset preparation stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for folder structure, labels, train/validation/test separation.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
